newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK DEPOS ARE SOFT, FX FORWARDS DIP IN LATE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK DEPOS ARE SOFT, FX FORWARDS DIP IN LATE TRADE.

text.p: Greek depo rates were softer and forex forwards had dipped an eighth of a point in late dealing as foreign players moved to capitalise on a lower interest rate outlook and drachma stability, dealers said.

"Depos are softer and forex forwards are down an eighth of a point in longer tenors," a senior dealer at a foreign bank said. "More players share the view that interest rates are going to fall and the drachma remain stable so they open new positions."
Other dealers said banks from abroad showed up after the central bank's fixing placing funds in longer tenors, especially one-year period, pushing rates lower.
The central bank drained overnight funds at an unchanged 12.40 percent.
Early elections will be held September 22 but the market has taken a positive attitude towards them on the ground that the winner will have no option but to follow Greece's EU convergence plan.
The mark was quoted at 159.18/23 drachmas from Wednesday's 159.085 fix, the dollar at 240.62/72 drachmas from 240.550 and the Ecu at 301.21/31 from 301.250 drachmas.
"There was very little interest at the fixing with small sums," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.
